title: When Does an AUROC Comparison Survive a Change in Population Mix?
abstract: arXiv:2611.19762v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Does an AUROC comparison survive a change in the proportions of tasks, populations, or image corruptions? A pooled-AUROC ranking of failure detectors or uncertainty scores describes one particular mix of groups. We study two fixed scores for a common binary target under mixtures of fixed group-conditional laws. Using the cross-group AUC decomposition, we prove that every rational symmetric quadratic comparison geometry is realizable by finite scalar-score distributions. Universal dominance is thus coNP-hard, and even exhaustive checks of every mixture on fewer than $K$ groups can miss a $K$-group reversal. A grid bound gives a dimension-uniform approximation certificate with sharp $1/m$ order. Common score marginals across groups make the comparison numerator linear, with an error envelope for imperfect alignment. These results yield exact finite-bank audits, explicit reversal mixtures and distances, and simultaneous population statement

translated_title: AUROC比较何时能在总体构成变化下依然成立？
translated_abstract: AUROC比较是否能在任务、人群或图像损坏比例发生变化后依然成立？基于池化AUROC的失败检测器或不确定性评分排名只描述了某一特定的群体混合比例。我们研究了在固定组条件分布的混合下，针对同一二元目标的两个固定评分。利用跨组AUC分解，我们证明了每一种有理对称二次比较几何都可以由有限的标量评分分布实现。因此，普遍支配性的判定是coNP困难的，即使穷举检查少于K个组的所有混合比例，也可能遗漏K个组情况下的排名反转。网格界限给出了一个与维度无关的近似证明，具有精确的1/m阶。当各组具有相同的评分边缘分布时，比较分子呈线性，并为不完全对齐的情况提供了误差包络。这些结果带来了精确的有限库审计、显式的反转混合比例与距离，以及同时性的总体陈述。
tldr: 本文通过跨组AUC分解证明，总体混合比例的任何变化都可能使AUROC排名发生反转且普遍支配性判定是coNP困难的，并给出网格界限与显式反转混合等工具用于精确审计排名稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper uses cross-group AUC decomposition to prove that AUROC rankings can reverse under any change in population mix, that universal dominance is coNP-hard, and provides grid bounds and explicit reversal mixtures for exact finite-bank audits.
